messages:
linh-cs: Hey team — IridiumX is kicking off a customer demo across EU and APAC in 2 hours, they need a short throughput bump and CIDR allow for a few IPs. Asking for a 30m elevated window (higher token QPS) and an incoming CIDR whitelist. Can we approve?
iridiumx-pm: @linh-cs thanks — demo starts 15:30 UTC, expecting steady traffic for 20–25m. CIDRs: 203.0.113.0/28 and 198.51.100.32/28. Will revert after demo. Need region pin to eu-west-1 and ap-southeast-1 if possible.
linh-cs: Noted. Requesting: 1) temporary throughput bump for those regions, 2) CIDR allow on control-plane and edges, 3) pin routing to regional POPs to avoid cross-region egress. Any objections?
rohit-sre: I can do the bump and whitelist, but we need an expiry and a rollback plan. I'll open CR-9876 and apply an auto-revoke after 40m. Also need approval from security for the CIDRs — I'll loop in sec.
anya-eng: For pinning, we can set a routing override per-customer to prefer eu-west-1 / ap-southeast-1, but note it only affects new connections; existing persistent sessions may remain on current backends. Are they okay with a short warm-up?
iridiumx-pm: Warm-up ok. We can schedule a quick client restart 5m before demo. Expiry 40m sounds good. Security ok to sign off on those two CIDRs — they're their demo infra.
rohit-sre: Created CR-9876: "IridiumX temporary regional throughput + CIDR allow — 40m auto-revoke". Owner @rohit-sre. Plan: apply whitelist on edges, bump route QPS limit to 4x baseline for eu & apac, add routing override tag iridiumx-demo, monitor for errors.
linh-cs: Can you paste the exact commands/config so I can share with IridiumX ops?
rohit-sre: Sure — runbook snippet: ```
# Apply CIDR allow
redwoodctl edge allow-cidr --customer=iridiumx --cidr=203.0.113.0/28 --reason="demo"
redwoodctl edge allow-cidr --customer=iridiumx --cidr=198.51.100.32/28 --reason="demo"
# Bump throughput (per-region)
redwoodctl quota set --customer=iridiumx --region=eu-west-1 --qps-multiplier=4 --expires-in=40m
redwoodctl quota set --customer=iridiumx --region=ap-southeast-1 --qps-multiplier=4 --expires-in=40m
# Add routing override tag
redwoodctl routing override --customer=iridiumx --preferred-regions=eu-west-1,ap-southeast-1 --tag=iridiumx-demo --expires-in=40m
```
anya-eng: Quick note — we should also enable prefix KV caching for their demo endpoints to reduce token cost spikes. I can enable a 5m cache for session prefixes scoped to /v1/generate for this customer. Do you want that included?
linh-cs: Yes please, include caching. Put it in the CR.
rohit-sre: Added cache line to CR and annotated monitoring alerts. Deploy-bot: patching allowed CIDRs and quotas now — logs at https://deploys.internal/redwood/CR-9876.
deploy-bot: apply: edge-allowlist/iridiumx -> success (203.0.113.0/28), success (198.51.100.32/28) | quotas/iridiumx -> success (eu-west-1, ap-southeast-1) | routing/override -> success | cache/kv -> success
linh-cs: Fantastic — can you confirm the exact revoke time?
rohit-sre: Auto-revoke scheduled for 40 minutes from now: TTL expiry 3415656750 (system epoch). I'll keep a manual revoke command handy if they end early: ```redwoodctl quota set --customer=iridiumx --region=all --qps-multiplier=1```
iridiumx-pm: Thanks everyone — sharing the runbook with my ops. We'll ping when demo is done for early rollback. Appreciate the quick turn. :rocket:
linh-cs: Closing loop here — capture this as a short-term enablement and note for renewal (they're on the fence about committed capacity — demo outcome will influence renewal). I'll add a recap to their account health doc and tag for follow-up next week.
rohit-sre: Marking CR-9876 resolved in 45m after auto-revoke unless manual rollback happens. Monitoring OK.
anya-eng: If demo shows sustained higher qps, recommend follow-up email to sales for a dedicated capacity trial.
linh-cs: Copy. Thanks all.
